name: Yamaha Motor
note: Naming/technical partner in the Lola Yamaha ABT Formula E team name. Left unrated for a maintainer: the owner is sourced (yamaha-motor-co-listed: listed in Tokyo, governments hold 0.0%), but the company test isn't settled. An Alabama jury found for a woman injured in 2007 when her Yamaha Rhino 660 off-road vehicle rolled over, on her wantonness claim against Yamaha; the Alabama Supreme Court affirmed the $3.3 million award in March 2015 (Law360, https://www.law360.com/articles/636731; the court's 2012 opinion sending the wantonness claim to a jury: https://caselaw.findlaw.com/court/al-supreme-court/1595756.html). Yamaha won most of the other Rhino trials. A maintainer decides whether a product-liability verdict like this one counts (3M is rated Concern on jury verdicts over its earplugs).
